stem.text: The graph shows the effect of three different partial pressures of carbon dioxide on the oxygen dissociation curve for human haemoglobin.

stem.alt: Oxygen dissociation graph with curves labelled X, Y and Z, y-axis percentage saturation of haemoglobin with oxygen from 0 to 100, x-axis partial pressure of oxygen / kPa from 0 to 12.

stem.text: What effect does decreasing the partial pressure of carbon dioxide have on haemoglobin?

A.text: It is less efficient at taking up oxygen and less efficient at releasing oxygen.

B.text: It is less efficient at taking up oxygen and more efficient at releasing oxygen.

C.text: It is more efficient at taking up oxygen and less efficient at releasing oxygen.

D.text: It is more efficient at taking up oxygen and more efficient at releasing oxygen.
